facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog says the main focus of its Product team is to align company strategy with user needs and bring maximum value to users.
facts.quote: The main focus of the Product team at StackAdapt is to align company strategy with user needs, and ultimately bring maximum value to our users.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog says its Product team gathers user feedback through client calls and client surveys.
facts.quote: We host client calls and client surveys, and we also collaborate with StackAdapt teams who work closely with our users

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog says its Product team does qualitative and quantitative research to identify user pain points before developing solutions.
facts.quote: We do a lot of qualitative and quantitative research to identify user pain points.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'Life in Adtech: Leveraging client feedback for product development' was published on 2022-06-21.
